Primitives: host need: the shared primitives every feature resolves (clock, identifiers)
Serialization: host need: the System.Text.Json payload serializer the runtime and the APIs use
Mediator: host need: the in-process mediator the design, publishing and runtime features send through
MemoryCache: host need: the cache the runtime and design features read through
Events: required by WorkflowDesignValidations, WorkflowsPublishing, WorkflowsRuntimeScheduling and ActivitiesDispatchWorkflowRuntime
Tasks: required by WorkflowsRuntimeResumption, WorkflowsRuntimeScheduling and WorkflowsRuntimeHttp; runs the reconciliation startup tasks
FileSystemDistributedLocking: host need: the lock provider Tasks resolves (TaskExecutor needs an IDistributedLockProvider)
ApiCapabilities: required by ExpressionsApi, ActivitiesDesignApi, WorkflowsDesignApi, WorkflowsPublishingApi and WorkflowsRuntimeApi
FoundationIdentityAbstractions: JTest template elsa-api-login-template (/_elsa/identity login and token); Studio sign-in
FoundationIdentityAspNetCoreIdentity: JTest template elsa-api-login-template: the cookie sign-in the login posts to; Studio sign-in (return URLs of the Studio host)
FoundationIdentityAspNetCoreIdentityEnti: JTest template elsa-api-login-template: the store of the seeded development administrator
FoundationIdentityOpenIddict: JTest template elsa-api-login-template: issues the bearer token every suite calls the API with; Studio sign-in
IdentityIamEntityFrameworkCore: required by FoundationIdentityApi and FoundationIdentityOpenIddict at runtime: the IAM authority (users, roles, applications) the token endpoint reads
Expressions: JTest suites: Literal, Object and Variable expressions
ExpressionsApi: Studio designer: the expression descriptors the editor reads
JavaScriptExpressions: JTest suites: JavaScript expressions (javascript suites and most others)
JavaScriptJintEngine: JTest suites: the engine JavaScript expressions and RunJavaScript run on
JavaScriptActivities: JTest suites: the JavaScript functions converted workflows call (variables, inputs, outputs)
JavaScriptWorkflowsDesign: Studio designer: JavaScript type definitions for the expression editor
Http: HTTP suites: the HTTP request and response model
HttpJavaScript: HTTP suites: JavaScript access to the HTTP request in converted expressions
ActivitiesHttp: HTTP suites and most others: HttpEndpoint and WriteHttpResponse, served under /workflows/http
WorkflowsRuntimeHttp: required by ActivitiesHttp: the route table of published and waiting HTTP endpoints
ActivitiesRuntime: JTest suites: the activity runtime every activity executes on
ActivitiesPrimitives: JTest suites: WriteLine, PublishEvent and the Event trigger (events suite)
ActivitiesControlFlow: JTest suites: If, Switch, For, ForEach, While and the parallel loops
ActivitiesFlowchart: JTest suites: Flowchart roots and their decision, fork, join and switch nodes
ActivitiesGraphRuntime: JTest suites: the graph runtime the roots execute on, with Complete and the step intrinsics converted SetVariable, SetOutput, SetName and Correlate become
ActivitiesGraphDesign: JTest suites and Studio designer: the graph structures a workflow's root is authored and published with
ActivitiesDispatchWorkflowRuntime: composition suites: DispatchWorkflow, BulkDispatchWorkflows and ExecuteWorkflow
ActivitiesDispatchWorkflowDesign: composition suites: the design side of the dispatch activities
ActivitiesDesignApi: Studio designer: the activity catalog API
ActivitiesDesignReconciliation: migrated folder: the activity reconciliation pass JsonActivityReconciliation and ClrActivityReconciliation feed
ClrActivityReconciliation: migrated folder: puts the built-in activities in the catalog, so imported workflows resolve their activity versions
ActivitiesDesignEntityFrameworkCore: host need: the activity catalog store (SQLite)
JsonActivityReconciliation: migrated folder: loads the activities file (converted reusables as composite activities)
WorkflowsDesignApi: Studio designer: the workflow definitions API
WorkflowDesignValidations: required by JsonWorkflowReconciliation, WorkflowsPublishing, WorkflowsDesignApi and ActivitiesDesignApi
WorkflowsDesignEntityFrameworkCore: host need: the workflow definition store (SQLite)
JsonWorkflowReconciliation: migrated folder: imports and publishes the workflows folder
WorkflowsPublishing: migrated folder: publish on reconcile; required by ActivitiesGraphDesign and ActivitiesDispatchWorkflowDesign
WorkflowsRuntimeApi: JTest templates elsa-api-workflow-execution, elsa-api-workflow-instance and elsa-api-activity-instance: /runtime/workflows executables, instances, activity executions and diagnostics settings
WorkflowsRuntimeEntityFrameworkCore: host need: the runtime store (SQLite) the instance and activity execution reads come from
WorkflowsRuntimeTriggers: required by WorkflowsPublishing and WorkflowsRuntimeHttp: indexes the triggers of published workflows (HTTP, Event)
WorkflowsRuntimeResumption: events and correlate suites: resumes waiting workflows on events and bookmarks; required by ActivitiesDispatchWorkflowRuntime and WorkflowsRuntimeEntityFrameworkCore
WorkflowsRuntimeScheduling: composition suites: runs dispatched and background workflow work
WorkflowsRuntimeRecurringTriggers: required by WorkflowsRuntimeEntityFrameworkCore at publication: every activation prepares its recurring-schedule projection, and publishing fails without it
WorkflowsRuntimeDistributed: HTTP suites: runs a workflow's commands through the execution actor as they are committed; without it a run only advances on the resumption sweep and a synchronous HTTP trigger times out (408)
WorkflowsRuntimeDistributedEntityFramewo: required by WorkflowsRuntimeDistributed: the execution placement store (SQLite)
WorkflowsRuntimeDistributedCommandTransp: required by WorkflowsRuntimeDistributed: the execution command transport (SQLite)
WorkflowsRuntimeCheckpointPersistence: S-15 run configuration: checkpoint persistence in Durable mode
WorkflowsRuntimeHistory: JTest template elsa-api-activity-instance: the activity execution history the suites read
